test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which scheme was launched in February 2022 to provide welfare and rehabilitation to the transgender community and the people engaged in the act of begging?
solution:
The correct answer is__** SMILE Scheme.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Dept of Social Justice and Empowerment will launch the scheme “**SMILE**: **Support for Marginalised Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise” on 12 February 2022.**
 
• There are 2 sub-schemes under this - ‘Central Sector Scheme for Comprehensive Rehabilitation for Welfare of Transgender Persons’ and ‘Central Sector Scheme for Comprehensive Rehabilitation of persons **engaged in the act of Begging’.**
 
• ​This umbrella scheme is designed to provide welfare measures to the Transgender community and the people engaged in the act of begging. 
 
• The Ministry has allocated **Rs. 365 Crore for the scheme from 2021-22 to 2025-26.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **CLAP** is a campaign to clean up rural areas in Andhra Pradesh.

 
 
• The Andhra Pradesh government had on October 2 started the Clean Andhra Pradesh (CLAP)-**Jagananna Swachha Sankalpam programme** to clean up rural areas, improve sanitation conditions and waste management with public participation.
 
• Rural households are told not to dispose of garbage on the streets and instead hand it over to the** garbage collector.**
 
 
 
• **PM-DevINE** will be implemented by the Ministry of DoNER through the North Eastern Council or Central Ministries/ agencies.
 
 
• Measures would be taken to ensure adequate operation and maintenance of the projects sanctioned under PM-DevINE so that they are sustainable.
 
• The PM-DevINE Scheme will have an outlay of Rs.6,600 crore for the four-year period from 2022-23 to 2025-26 (remaining years of the 15th Finance Commission period).
 
 
 
• **Operation Sadbhavana**, also referred to as Operation Goodwill has been launched in Jammu and Kashmir by the Indian Army under their Military Civic Action programs.
 
 
• It is aimed at "Winning the Hearts and Minds" (WHAM) of the people in the region.
